text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now then, time for the Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Let us go, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroom, VRRRROOOOM!)
choice_data_list: What is it all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What's with the buzzkill attitude, hmm? 
It's obviously meant to hype us up for 
your debut battle~."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Granted, today's opponents are all raw 
recruits. Perhaps no cheering up is even 
necessary, hoho.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyah-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Putting aside that she was a new recruit 
herself, No Reason stepped out into the 
hallway with utter composure.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyah-ha-ha... huh?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
――!? Lord Universe? Is that you, Lord Neo 
Universe?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(One of the Silent Clan. Word has it she 
wields the power of the stars and is quite 
the formidable warrior...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why are you here...?! Word was your Make a 
Debut wouldn't be until next year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (VRRROOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's this? A blackout?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nowah...??? Lord... Universe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What was that all about? Just now, she 
was certainly Neo Universe, the slightly 
mysterious sci-fi Umamusume. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a momentary blackout, they suddenly 
vanished into thin air. What in the world 
was that...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, could this be the work of an 
illusionist? Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Very well! We shall see from the race 
card whether Universe-dono is truly 
entering or not."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as expected, Lady Universe's name was 
not upon the race roster.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they won't be showing up today. 
They would've been a tough opponent, so 
that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I scan the surroundings as well, but— Neo 
Universe is nowhere to be seen...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Still, 'tis quite eerie. Whether they be 
here or not, 'tis just like a ninja.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet I shall not be swayed by such 
trivialities! Trainer, behold my running 
with your own eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of No Reason. With top-notch 
grit, she regained her composure in an 
instant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it took me by surprise, there 
didn't seem to be any issues at all with 
the race itself.
